# Business Anatomy

> Business Anatomy is a digital agency that builds and elevates brands through
> strategy, design, and innovation — digital marketing, web development,
> branding, and business growth consulting.

- [Case Studies](https://businessanatomy.co.uk/case-studies): Client project outcomes.
- [Blog](https://businessanatomy.co.uk/blog): Articles and insights.
